test_title: PYST 71: SSC GD Constable - GA & GK (Held On - 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Read the following about the impact of Green Revolution in India.

A. India became self-sufficient in food-grains and had sufficient stock in the central pool, even, at times, India was in a position to export food-grains.

B. The per capita net availability of food-grains has also increased.

Identify the CORRECT statement/statements.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and B**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Green Revolution refers to a period of agricultural transformation that occurred in the **1960s and 1970s**.
 
• High-Yielding Varieties (HYVs) Developed through selective breeding and hybridization.
 
• Increased use of chemical fertilizers, particularly **nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), and potassium (K)**.
 
• The Father of the Green Revolution in India is **Dr. M. S. Swaminathan**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
